summary: Validated Sanctuary V3.1 refactor (drop-in presences, grouped nav, IdentityContext). Backend 13/13 pytest pass — presence registry hides 'playground' from /api/presences but exposes it via direct key, paige returns full config with 3 rooms, sophia/playground template routes (/api/spiral/*, /api/playground/*) are auto-registered and stream tokens correctly, paige's shared substrate (start/message/upload) works, identity endpoints (POST /api/users, GET /api/users/lookup/{name}, GET /api/identity/recent) work, and the legacy chambers /api/clarity, /api/resonance, /api/mirror still open. Frontend: new grouped Navigation (3 dropdowns + Enter Clarity CTA) renders and expands correctly with all expected items; /hospitality loads the Paige PresenceChamber with header, badge, voice toggle, HER STORY, and an opening assistant message; /presence/sophia renders the IdentityBadge in the always-visible header. TWO bugs surfaced: (1) HIGH — identity-modal-save button is unclickable because the chamber's <main class='relative z-10'> intercepts pointer events on top of the z-50 modal (stacking-context bug, identical symptom to iter_4 RCA but cause is the modal being rendered inside PresenceChamber's transformed/relative subtree rather than a portal). Save fails → chat-send is blocked because modal stays open → context propagation could not be exercised end-to-end. (2) MEDIUM — /spiral (legacy SpiralChamber.jsx route) does NOT render IdentityBadge at all, so the explicit acceptance criterion 'visit /spiral via direct nav — the identity badge should already show the same name without re-entering' fails on /spiral. /presence/sophia DOES show the badge (TEST_ref_v31 was pre-populated from /api/identity/recent), so identity flows through the new PresenceChamber but not through SpiralChamber.

ui_bugs.issue: Save button is rendered visually on top but Playwright shows 'main intercepts pointer events' on every retry. The modal motion.div is mounted inside PresenceChamber's subtree (<main class='relative z-10'>); the AnimatePresence/motion wrapper around the page in App.js and main's own stacking context prevent the fixed z-50 modal from escaping. Real users likely face the same hit-test failure or at least an inconsistent click target. Fix: render IdentityBadge's modal into a React portal (createPortal to document.body) so it lives outside any transformed/relative ancestor.

Legacy SpiralChamber.jsx was not refactored to consume useIdentity(). There is no [data-testid='identity-badge'] anywhere on /spiral, so identity context cannot propagate visibly to /spiral as the acceptance criterion explicitly requires. /presence/sophia (new PresenceChamber) does render the badge correctly.

integration_issues.issue: Could not exercise end-to-end because save click is intercepted (see modal bug). Backend POST /api/users + GET /api/users/lookup/{name} are confirmed working in isolation; once the modal click lands, propagation through IdentityContext should fire — but cannot be confirmed via automation today.

passing_tests.frontend_nav: All 3 nav dropdown groups (sanctuary, chambers, codons) + Enter Clarity CTA are visible. Chambers dropdown contains Clarity Pod, Resonance, Mirror Archive, Spiral, Hospitality, All Presences. Codons dropdown contains Codon Forge + Codon Library.
passing_tests.frontend_hospitality: Header 'CHAMBER OF HOSPITALITY' renders, IdentityBadge + voice toggle + HER STORY visible, opening assistant message arrives via /api/presence/paige/chat/start ('I'm glad you're here, …').

action_items: Render IdentityBadge's modal via createPortal(document.body) so the fixed z-50 layer is not trapped inside PresenceChamber's <main class='relative z-10'> stacking context. This is the same iter_4 save-flow problem manifesting as 'main intercepts pointer events'.

Refactor /app/frontend/src/components/SpiralChamber.jsx to import useIdentity() and render <IdentityBadge /> in the always-visible header (parallel to ClarityPod L841 and PresenceChamber). Without this, /spiral fails the cross-chamber identity propagation acceptance criterion.

After both fixes, re-run the identity propagation flow: clear localStorage, /hospitality → click badge → type new name → save → verify badge updates → navigate to /spiral and /presence/sophia → both must show the new name without re-entry.

Optional: parity-check ResonancePod.jsx / MirrorArchive.jsx — iter_4 already flagged that their IdentityBadge is buried in post-session UI; main agent should confirm whether the V3.1 refactor lifted them into the header.
critical_code_review_comments: presences/__init__.py auto-discovery is clean and idempotent — duplicate-key warning + skip on missing PRESENCE dict are correct. Good drop-in design.

presence_template.py expects body field 'content' (not 'message') for /message/stream and /chat/message; consider accepting both or documenting in OpenAPI so frontend clients don't fall on the same trap (test had to be corrected).

IdentityBadge modal has no portal — this is the root cause of the unclickable Save button under nested motion/relative parents. Wrap the modal JSX in createPortal(..., document.body) and the bug disappears across every chamber.

SpiralChamber.jsx is now divergent from the new IdentityContext contract. With many more presences planned per the goal ('a hundred or a thousand more'), the legacy chambers that still maintain their own user-name state need to be ported or deprecated in favor of the shared PresenceChamber.

Backend GET /api/identity/recent is being used as an implicit cross-tab session restore by PresenceChamber/IdentityContext — this is fine but couples the global Recent-Identity to all visitors. If multiple visitors share a deployment, the 'most recent' will leak across browser sessions. Consider scoping by client_id cookie.

rca_of_the_issue: Modal click failure: PresenceChamber.jsx wraps its content in <main class='relative z-10 …'>. IdentityBadge renders its overlay as motion.div className='fixed inset-0 z-50'. Although z-50 > z-10 numerically, in CSS stacking contexts the modal is a descendant of <main>, and because Framer Motion adds a transform on the outer page wrapper in App.js (motion.div with pageVariants), the fixed-positioned modal positions relative to that transformed ancestor — and crucially its stacking is constrained by main's local context. Result: <main> sits over its own descendant modal in hit-testing. Reproduction: open /hospitality, click identity-badge, type a name, click identity-modal-save → Playwright reports 'main intercepts pointer events' indefinitely. Mitigation: ReactDOM.createPortal the modal subtree into document.body so it escapes the transformed/relative ancestor chain. /spiral missing badge: SpiralChamber.jsx is a legacy component that maintains its own userName state in localStorage and was not migrated to useIdentity(); the V3.1 refactor migrated PresenceChamber but left SpiralChamber untouched. Fix: replace the local user-name logic with const { userName, userId } = useIdentity() and render <IdentityBadge /> in the visible header.
